import hashlib
import inspect
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import scar.ir.program.codec as codec
import tests.fixtures.program_method_lookup_graphs as fixture

tree = Path.cwd().resolve()
modules = {"encoder": codec, "fixture": fixture}
sources = {}
for label, module in modules.items():
    path = Path(inspect.getfile(module)).resolve()
    assert path.is_relative_to(tree), (label, path, tree)
    sources[label] = {"path": str(path.relative_to(tree)),
                      "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
assert codec.SCHEMA_VERSION == 20
graph, _ = fixture.method_lookup_program(request="send")
wire = codec.dumps(graph).encode("ascii")
document = json.loads(wire)
assert document["schema_version"] == 20
assert "exception_matches" not in document
assert document["protocol_operations"] and document["protocol_call_inputs"]
assert document["protocol_result_consumers"]
assert codec.dumps(codec.loads(wire.decode("ascii"))).encode("ascii") == wire
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_bytes(wire)
print(json.dumps({"schema_version": 20, "python_version": sys.version,
                  "fixture_bytes": len(wire),
                  "fixture_sha256": hashlib.sha256(wire).hexdigest(),
                  "sources": sources}, sort_keys=True))
